# Getting help

- **How do I …?** The [user manual](https://kybl.app/manual/) covers every feature, the keyboard
  shortcuts and common problems. In the app, press F1, or use Help → Kybl Manual.
- **Something's broken.** Open a [bug report](https://github.com/erikkubica/kybl/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
  The Activity panel's **Log** tab usually says what failed.
- **An idea.** Open a [feature request](https://github.com/erikkubica/kybl/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **A security problem.** Report it privately: see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
